name: Ivy
source:
Track star, struggling with her studies, recently single, gossip girl, and irritated with her new living arrangements, Ivy has a lot on her plate.

Her dad is the Principal at school, her stepmom is brand new, and her step sister keeps giving her strange looks. Her brother is next to no use, so Ivy uses every excuse possible to stay away from that mad house.

At least she can rely on her friends for support and to provide entertainment during these trying times.

And then she has her running. Nothing makes her feel as free. Nothing makes her forget her troubles like the sprint. Existing in that moment, sweat and speed her only companions, is a thrill she is addicted to chasing.

Nothing comes close to that exquisite escape.

Or so she thinks...
